text: [INSTITUTIONAL HANDBOOK 2026] 1. ADMISSIONS 1.1 Eligibility To be eligible for undergraduate programs, a student must have passed their 12th standard (or equivalent) examination with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks. For postgraduate programs, a bachelor's degree with at least 55% aggregate is required. 2. FEES AND PAYMENTS 2.1 Semester Fee Deadline The deadline to pay the even semester fees is March 15th of every year. The odd semester fee deadline is August 20th. A late fee of $50 is applied if paid within 15 days after the deadline. After 15 days, the student may not be allowed to attend classes. 2.2 Fee Waivers Fee waivers are available for students from economically weaker sections. To apply for a fee waiver, a student must submit the income certificate of their parents along with the fee waiver application form to the administrative office by September 1st. 3. EXAMINATIONS 3.1 Attendance Requirement A minimum attendance of 75% in each subject is mandatory to be eligible to sit for the end-semester examinations. Medical leaves up to 10% can be considered, subject to the submission of a valid medical certificate from a registered practitioner within one week of rejoining. 4. HOSTEL 4.1 Application Process Students must apply for a hostel room online through the student portal before July 10th. Room allocation is based on distance from hometown and academic merit. Hostel fees must be paid in full before moving in. 4.2 Rules Consumption of alcohol or illegal substances in the hostel premises is strictly prohibited

Curfew timing for all students in the hostel is 10:00 PM. No student is allowed to enter or leave the hostel after 10:00 PM without prior written permission from the warden.

[SCHOLARSHIP AND FEE WAIVER CIRCULAR – 2026] 1. SCHOLARSHIPS AVAILABLE 1.1 Merit Scholarship Students scoring above 90% aggregate in the previous semester examinations are eligible for the Merit Scholarship. The scholarship covers 50% of the tuition fee for the following semester. Applications must be submitted by October 5th through the student portal. 1.2 Need-Based Scholarship Students from families with an annual income below Rs. 3,00,000 are eligible for a need-based scholarship. Required documents: income certificate (issued by a Gazetted Officer), latest bank statement, and the scholarship application form. Submit all documents to the Financial Aid Office before September 15th. 2. FEE PAYMENT PORTAL All fees must be paid via the official student portal at portal.institution.edu. Accepted payment modes: Net Banking, UPI, Debit Card, and Credit Card. Fee receipts are automatically emailed to the registered student email within 24 hours of payment. 3. REFUND POLICY A full refund of tuition fees is available if a student withdraws before the end of the first week of classes. A 50% refund is applicable if withdrawal happens within two weeks. No refund is issued after the second week of the semester. 4. EXAMINATION FEE The examination registration fee is Rs. 1,200 per semester. Students must register for examinations through the student portal at least 30 days before the examination dates. Late registration is subject to an additional fee of Rs. 300.
